description: Na₂LiFeCPO₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.80 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.82 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.86 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra and corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 65°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.53 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.47 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.36 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-60°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-50°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONaLiFeP tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramid and corners with two equivalent ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂FeP tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂LiC tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramids. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Li, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₂LiC tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂FeP tetrahedra.
